'''Alther's Mill''' is an abandoned lumber mill located northeast of [[Lakeshire]] in the [[Redridge Mountains]] [[region]] of [[Stormwind (kingdom)|Stormwind]]. This is a relatively backwater area that is overrun by [[spider]]s, [[buzzard]]s and the occasional stray [[orc]]. Most folks pass through on the way to [[Stonewatch Keep]].

==Notes==
* [[Alliance]] [[rogue]]s are required to visit the mill to get their thieving certificate, and there are footlockers around the area to practice [[lockpicking]] on.
